metadata.name: perpetua
metadata.description: Perpetua: non-custodial onchain inheritance on Solana

accounts.name: reserve
docs: The owner's own wSOL reserve: a token account whose authority is the owner, at an
address derived from the switch so DEX routers never touch or close it.

accounts.name: source
docs: because it may have been closed, re-delegated or frozen.

fields.name: token_account
docs: The owner's token account the switch PDA is delegate on. For SOL this is the
owner's reserve wSOL account (authority = owner).

fields.name: recipient
docs: Heir index that receives the whole asset, or SPLIT.

fields.name: approved
docs: Amount approved (delegated) at the last edit.

fields.name: escrowed
docs: Amount held for heirs after settlement and fee.

fields.name: delivered
docs: Bit i set = heir i has received their share.

fields.name: admin
docs: Can set the engine wallet, pause new setups and set the $PERPETUA mint once.
Cannot touch any switch or any user asset.

fields.name: engine
docs: Buyback engine wallet: the only key that can move funds out of the treasury PDA.

fields.name: perpetua_mint
docs: $PERPETUA mint used for tier checks. Default (all zeros) until set; set once only.

fields.name: paused
docs: Pauses creation of new switches only. Check-ins, edits, cancels and execution never pause.

fields.name: to_treasury
docs: True when a SOL share was too small to open an empty wallet and went to the treasury.

fields.name: bps
docs: Share in basis points. All heirs sum to exactly 10_000.

fields.name: letter
docs: SHA-256 of the sealed letter envelope for this heir, or zeros for no letter.

types.name: Switch
docs: Field order is part of the public interface: the letter release service reads
`status` at byte offset 45 (8 discriminator + 32 owner + 4 id + 1 bump).

constants.name: CUSTOM_INTERVAL_MIN_DAYS
docs: Patron tier: any interval from 7 days to 5 years.

constants.name: EXECUTION_FEE_BPS
docs: Execution fee on assets delivered, in basis points (0.5%).

constants.name: GRACE_DAYS
docs: Grace period after a missed deadline before anyone can trigger execution.

constants.name: HOLDER_THRESHOLD_TOKENS
docs: $PERPETUA held (whole tokens) for each tier.

constants.name: MAX_ASSETS
docs: Assets per switch. Cancelling revokes every delegation in one transaction.

constants.name: MIN_SOL_LAMPORTS
docs: Smallest SOL amount that can be set aside for heirs (0.01 SOL).

constants.name: PATRON_MAX_HEIRS
docs: Protocol maximum. Sixteen heirs is what fits in one wallet-signed transaction
with room left for wallet safety guards.

constants.name: SETUP_FEE_LAMPORTS
docs: One-time fee for a Free-tier switch, paid into the treasury PDA by the program.

constants.name: SKIP_AFTER_DAYS
docs: After execution starts, an asset that still cannot be settled may be skipped after this long.

constants.name: STANDARD_INTERVAL_DAYS
docs: Check-in intervals available to every tier.
